checks.name: Body ≤ 3,500 words
checks.note: Maximum length: 3500 words of text, not including abstract, tables, figures, references, and online-only material.

checks.name: Title ≤ 100 characters
checks.note: Including spaces. Research reports and major articles 100; shorter article types 60.

checks.name: Sections match the journal's structure
checks.note: Every section marked required in the structure file must be present and non-empty

checks.name: Cover letter present
checks.note: Complete contact information for the corresponding author and whether the authors have published, posted, or submitted any related papers from the same study.

checks.name: Reporting guideline followed and checklist attached
checks.note: The EQUATOR guideline for the study design (CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, STARD, …), named in the Methods.

checks.name: Presubmission inquiry sent and encouraged by the editors
checks.note: This article type requires a presubmission inquiry.

checks.name: Acknowledgment complete: contributions, data access statement, disclosures, funding and its role
Conflict of interest disclosures for every author
checks.note: Complete disclosure of all relevant financial relationships; authors with none say so.
